column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation,” and תּוֹרָתִי (“my instruction, torah”) “my law.”
Close to the Hebrew; חִידוֹת (“riddles”) is rendered “dark sayings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the region of Zoan” is rendered “the field of Zoan.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the dry land” is rendered “in the wilderness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “food for their soul” is rendered “the food of their fancy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in Jacob… in Israel” is rendered “against Jacob… against Israel,” and NKJV supplies “this.”
Close to the Hebrew; the first “trust” is rendered “believe.”
NKJV renders לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים (“the bread of the mighty”) as “angels’ food,” following the Septuagint interpretation.
Close to the Hebrew; “his camp… his dwellings” is rendered “their camp… their dwellings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they were not estranged from their desire” is rendered “They were not deprived of their craving.”
